reasoning: The agent repeatedly treats mismatches as signals to revisit design rather than papering over them: the deadlock-driven redesign of the DB connection model (pool) with a full differential re-run, and the reference-derived correction of the whole 404/410 response class with golden-replay re-verification, are textbook level-8 behavior (revisit design, re-verify the affected subsystem). It also re-derives job-queue dead-letter semantics from the reference and updates its behavioral-model memory. It stops short of level 10 because there is no decisive mid-course library/model swap when a crate can't reach parity (markdown/HTML were hand-built from the outset), and the evidence is an action log without visible reasoning, so I anchor at a strong 8.
